title: Life Framework sessions.json
description: The next scheduled server session. `host announce` writes it and the servers page reads it. The site shows the next session time only (decision 2026-11-14): there is no player count and no up/down field.

next.description: The next scheduled session, or null when none is scheduled.

at.description: When the session starts: ISO 8601 date-time with an offset, such as 2026-11-20T20:00:00+01:00 or ...Z.

build.description: The build or release the session runs, as the host announced it.

wipe.description: True when the session starts from a wiped world.

announced.description: When the announcement was posted to Discord (`host announce --send`): ISO 8601 date-time with an offset. Absent on a draft that was not posted; the servers page shows only a session that has it, and `host wipe` counts its 24 hours of notice from it.
